specs.title: Onboarding intake (setup agent)
specs.why: Self-serve onboarding is what makes the product scale without hand-holding each merchant.
specs.scope: Single chat surface where the setup agent extracts business type, location, hours, services, payment provider and deposit policy, producing a draft tenant config.
tasks: Setup agent prompt with extraction tools
WhatsApp entry point for the same agent
acceptance: A single descriptive message yields a complete draft config
A dropped session can be recovered

specs.title: Config preview and confirm
specs.why: The owner must be able to see and correct what the agent understood before a tenant is created.
specs.scope: Show the parsed tenant, services and hours to the owner. Owner edits in natural language. On confirm, create the tenant, provision the booking link and link the WhatsApp number where applicable.
tasks: Preview card rendered in chat and web
Confirm handler creates the full tenant from the draft
Telemetry timer from start to confirm
acceptance: The round trip completes in under 5 minutes in a scripted test
Confirm creates tenant, services, hours and booking link
